title: A Muslim's Day
paragraphs: Ahmad bangun pagi-pagi, sebelum matahari terbit, untuk shalat Subuh. Langit di luar masih gelap dan sunyi. Ia shalat dengan tenang, lalu duduk sejenak membaca sedikit Al-Qur'an sebelum memeriksa ponselnya untuk jadwal hari itu. Setelah shalat, ia makan sarapan sederhana berupa roti dan teh. Kemudian ia berkendara ke kantornya di kota. Ia bekerja keras melalui beberapa rapat, dan berhenti sebentar saat tengah hari untuk shalat Dzuhur sebelum melanjutkan pekerjaannya.

Di sore hari, ia pulang dengan perasaan lelah namun benar-benar puas dengan pekerjaannya hari itu. Ia shalat Maghrib bersama istrinya sebelum makan malam, dan mereka berbincang pelan tentang rencana akhir pekan mendatang. Sebelum tidur, Ahmad merenung sejenak tentang harinya. Ia menyadari bahwa bahkan di hari-hari tersibuknya, lima waktu shalat memberi ritme yang stabil pada jadwalnya, sesuatu untuk kembali diingat betapa pun beratnya pekerjaan.
answerKey: Ahmad wakes up early, before sunrise, for Fajr prayer. The sky outside is still dark and quiet. He prays calmly, then sits for a moment to read a little Quran before checking his phone for the day's schedule. After prayer, he eats a simple breakfast of bread and tea. Then he drives to his office in the city. He works hard through several meetings, and pauses briefly at midday for the noon prayer, Dhuhr, before continuing. In the evening, he comes home feeling tired but genuinely satisfied with his day's work. He prays Maghrib together with his wife before dinner, and they talk quietly about their plans for the coming weekend. Before sleeping, Ahmad reflects for a moment on his day. He notices that even on his busiest days, the five prayers give his schedule a steady rhythm, something to return to no matter how demanding work becomes.
